title: View note
description: A page the cockpit shows from one data file in the repo, declared in docs/_meta/views/. The note's body describes it.

name.description: Lowercase words joined by hyphens; the note is <name>.md.

title.description: The tab label in the cockpit.

type.description: One of the view types nexus ships.

data.description: The data file (or, for a gallery, a folder) as a path from the repo root, outside docs/.

component.description: A registered component the view belongs to.

columns.description: Which columns to show, in order.

column.description: The column to sort by, by name.

chart.description: Chart options: required for a chart view.

y.description: The column, or columns, drawn as series.
